What shortwave stations can I hear in Australia?

Tonight's best bets in Australia include RNZ Pacific on 9700 kHz, Voice of Korea on 6185 kHz, China Radio International on 11905 kHz. Stations beamed at Australia and the Pacific are the easiest catches; the tables on this page are rebuilt daily from the published schedule.

What time is best for shortwave listening in Australia?

Evening and night are best for distant stations. In Australia the evening bands are usually 41, 31 and 25 metres (7, 9.5 and 12 MHz); stations aimed at Asia and the Pacific are often audible too.

Are there English shortwave broadcasts to Australia?

Yes. 29 stations broadcast in English toward Australia and the Pacific this season, including KBS World Radio, China Radio International, RNZ Pacific, NHK Radio Japan.

How do I convert shortwave UTC times to Australia time?

Shortwave schedules use UTC. Australia is currently on AEDT (Sydney/Melbourne), which is UTC+11. This page already shows times in local time.

Can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Yes. Free WebSDR and KiwiSDR receivers let you tune real shortwave receivers in your browser. See the Listen Online page.
